admission_rule: A paper case must name a failure mechanism, a public benchmark/data source, a proposed repair, and the model access needed to reproduce that repair. A black-box endpoint may run the diagnosis and safe controls, but must report an unavailable paper method rather than relabel a different intervention as a reproduction.

cases.title: MLLMs Know Where to Look
cases.mechanism: the model can localize the small detail but cannot perceive it at the input resolution
cases.paper_repair: ViCrop: relative-attention, gradient-weighted attention, or input-gradient localization; provide original image plus crop
cases.black_box_status: chat-completions endpoint: human-CROP oracle only; hf_local LLaVA: automated relative-attention ViCrop L3a route

cases.title: V*: Guided Visual Search as a Core Mechanism in Multimodal LLMs
cases.failure_slice: high-resolution, visually crowded questions in V*Bench
cases.mechanism: the model lacks question-guided visual search over the relevant detail
cases.paper_repair: SEAL: LLM-guided visual search and targeted visual querying
cases.black_box_status: candidate crops are runnable; trained SEAL is not a black-box reproduction

cases.title: Mitigating Object Hallucinations through Visual Contrastive Decoding
cases.mechanism: language priors and statistical bias override visual evidence
cases.paper_repair: contrast logits from original and distorted visual inputs during decoding
cases.black_box_status: prompt/crop controls runnable; exact VCD unavailable without logits

cases.title: OPERA: Over-Trust Penalty and Retrospection-Allocation
cases.mechanism: decoding over-trusts a few summary tokens and neglects image tokens
cases.paper_repair: attention-derived logit penalty with beam-search rollback/reallocation
cases.black_box_status: not reproducible through a chat-completions endpoint

cases.title: Paying More Attention to Image
cases.failure_slice: POPE object-presence questions affected by language-prior hallucination
cases.mechanism: the generated token under-attends to the image-token interval during decoding
cases.paper_repair: increase the pre-softmax attention scores from the final generated token to image tokens; the full method additionally uses classifier-free guidance
cases.black_box_status: not reproducible through a chat-completions endpoint; hf_local LLaVA runs the released attention boost and image-free CFG cache as a native architecture specialization

cases.title: Internal Fact-based Contrastive Decoding
cases.mechanism: representation perturbation amplifies language-biased hallucination logits
cases.paper_repair: contrast normal and internally disturbed output distributions at decoding time
cases.black_box_status: not reproducible through a chat-completions endpoint

cases.title: Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models with Instruction Contrastive Decoding
cases.failure_slice: POPE object-presence questions susceptible to language priors
cases.mechanism: a disturbance instruction amplifies hallucinated concepts in the multimodal alignment path
cases.paper_repair: contrast normal and disturbance-instruction logits during decoding
cases.black_box_status: not reproducible through a chat-completions endpoint; hf_local provides an explicitly labelled decoder-input adaptation for Q-Former-free VLMs

cases.title: DyFo: A Training-Free Dynamic Focus Visual Search for Enhancing LMMs in Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
cases.failure_slice: V*Bench and POPE fine-grained questions where the relevant detail needs focus adjustment
cases.mechanism: without explicit visual search the model never focuses on the question-relevant region
cases.paper_repair: Monte Carlo Tree Search over focus regions: the LMM and external visual experts bidirectionally propose and score zoomed sub-views; answers from focused views are aggregated by voting
cases.black_box_status: fully runnable against a chat endpoint plus local expert tools; a trained-component-free sibling of the V* search family

cases.title: Divide, Conquer and Combine: A Training-Free Framework for High-Resolution Image Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
cases.mechanism: downsampling to the model's input resolution destroys the fine-grained evidence the question asks about
cases.paper_repair: recursively divide the image into patches (merging visually similar ones), have the model describe each patch, then answer from the aggregated descriptions plus the full image
cases.black_box_status: fully runnable black-box; the purest crop/describe/re-ask loop in the casebook, so it doubles as the cheapest paper-method integration test

cases.title: Retrieval-Augmented Perception: High-Resolution Image Perception Meets Visual RAG
cases.failure_slice: high-resolution images where the answer-bearing evidence occupies a small fraction of the pixels
cases.mechanism: encoding the full image at once dilutes query-relevant regions in the visual front end
cases.paper_repair: retrieve query-relevant crops with an external scorer, re-assemble them with a spatial-awareness layout, and adaptively choose the number of crops via Retrieved-Exploration Search
cases.black_box_status: crop retrieval and layout are black-box; exact RE-Search wants token logprobs — with a verbalized-confidence substitute the search variant must be recorded as adapted

cases.title: API: Attention Prompting on Image for Large Vision-Language Models
cases.failure_slice: questions whose answer region the model under-attends at input time
cases.mechanism: nothing steers the target model toward the question-relevant region of the image
cases.paper_repair: an auxiliary model (CLIP or LLaVA-1.5) computes a text-query-conditioned attention heatmap that is overlaid as a soft mask on the image before querying the target model
cases.black_box_status: target VLM stays black-box; the auxiliary heatmap model runs locally — the overlay counterpart of ViCrop's crop, so the pair separates 'better view' from 'steered view'

cases.title: Compositional Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Large Multimodal Models
cases.failure_slice: compositional questions where object/attribute/relation structure is ignored
cases.mechanism: the model answers from surface features without extracting the compositional structure of the scene
cases.paper_repair: two-step zero-shot prompting: first generate a scene graph for the image and question, then answer with the scene graph in context
cases.black_box_status: fully runnable black-box; also a discriminant-validity control — a diagnosis of perception-limited failure should NOT select a prompt-only scaffold as the winning fix
